narration: Your morning commute feels harmless — but most Americans have no idea it's quietly draining over twelve thousand dollars a year. There's a financial monster hiding in plain sight.
visual: Amber car SVG slides in from the right against dark background. Dollar counter animates from $0 to $12,800 as the title 'YOUR COMMUTE'S HIDDEN PRICE TAG' springs onto screen.

narration: Start with your time. The average commuter burns two hundred twenty-five hours a year in traffic — that's twenty-eight full work days you'll never get paid for.
visual: Light background with '225 HOURS' headline springing in. Calendar grid of 28 amber cells animates X-marks appearing one by one until all 28 are crossed out.

narration: Then there's your car. At sixty-seven cents per mile, a typical thirty-two mile daily commute costs over fifty-three hundred dollars a year — and that's before the coffee.
visual: Gas pump SVG springs up on dark background. Dollar counter climbs from $0 to $5,360 with a filling amber progress bar. Math shown: '32 miles/day × $0.67/mile × 250 days'.

narration: Add the extras — commute coffees, office lunches, work clothes. Those silent add-ons quietly stack another twenty-two hundred dollars onto your annual tab.
visual: Light background. Coffee cup, lunch bag, and briefcase SVGs spring in one by one with yearly cost labels ($730, $1,100, $370). Total '$2,200/YEAR' fades in below.

narration: Add it all up: twelve thousand eight hundred dollars a year. Invest that for thirty years at ten percent returns — your commute just cost you two point two million dollars.
visual: Dark background bar chart with two bars growing upward. Small gray bar labels $12,800. Towering amber bar labels $2.2M. Title: 'IF YOU INVESTED IT INSTEAD — 30 YEARS AT 10%'.

narration: Now you know. Your commute isn't just lost time — it's two million dollars in lifetime wealth. Make the move. Follow for more money math.
